title: NEW DAY
lines: New day is an underwater data center.
It keeps 949 shots from 124 films. Every film is a tower, every shot a floor, every frame a window.
Its 5 streets are the scenes of the poem, in order: the first is “Return to chapel shore and dismount”.
The tallest tower is THE PHOTOGRAPHER (1948): 36 floors.
Nothing in it is older than 1914 or newer than 2021.
The sign most often read here is bodies of gest.
